dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline starting from the posterior ridge, transitioning to a slightly convex profile toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius curvature classified as acute-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Low-gradient angular steepness, approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide-based morphology with a pixel ratio of approximately 2.2:1 (base width to vertical height).

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius, shallow convex arc with minimal vertical protrusion from the cranial midline.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extending anteriorly with a downward-oriented distal terminus.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Wide obtuse angle of approximately 160 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous circular white depigmentation spots and linear parallel scratch marks (tooth rakes) visible across the dorsal fin and lateral body surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white punctate mottling distributed across the dark-pigmented integument.
